prompts.display_text: Pin a continental Western European country (not Luxembourg or a microstate) an Apostle dedicated or rededicated, 1966 to 1998
prompts.text_original: Many European lands were first dedicated in the 1850s; later Apostles dedicated new ones or rededicated old ones. One of nine continental Western European countries (Portugal, Spain, France, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, Germany, Belgium or the Netherlands) that an Apostle dedicated or rededicated for the preaching of the gospel between 1966 and 1998.
prompts.note: France (1850) and Switzerland (1851) were dedicated long before. Germany counts through the 1975 East German dedication.
prompts.summary: Between 1966 and 1998 Apostles offered dedicatory prayers over seven Western European lands. Ezra Taft Benson rededicated Italy in 1966 and Marion G. Romney dedicated Spain in 1968. Thomas S. Monson dedicated East Germany and Portugal in 1975. L. Tom Perry and Howard W. Hunter dedicated the Netherlands and Austria in 1992, and Jeffrey R. Holland rededicated Belgium in 1998.

answers.name: Spain
answers.fact: Elder Marion G. Romney dedicated Spain from Casa de Campo in Madrid, October 1968.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: Ezra Taft Benson rededicated Italy at Torre Pellice, where Lorenzo Snow had dedicated it, November 10, 1966.

answers.name: Austria
answers.fact: Howard W. Hunter dedicated Austria from the Kahlenberg above Vienna, September 12, 1992.

answers.name: Germany
answers.fact: Elder Thomas S. Monson dedicated the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) on a hillside near Radebeul, April 27, 1975.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: Elder L. Tom Perry dedicated the Netherlands, September 10, 1992.

answers.name: Portugal
answers.fact: Elder Thomas S. Monson dedicated Portugal near the Sintra Mountains, March 1975.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: Elder Jeffrey R. Holland rededicated Belgium at Tervuren, May 26, 1998.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Central American country an Apostle opened to missionaries with a prayer of dedication (or rededication), 1990-1992
prompts.text_original: Spencer W. Kimball dedicated all of Central America in 1952. Between 1990 and 1992 Apostles returned and dedicated (or, in one case, rededicated) each Central American country individually for the preaching of the gospel. A Central American country dedicated in that period.
prompts.summary: Elder Spencer W. Kimball dedicated Central America as a whole in 1952. In a burst from 1990 to 1992, Russell M. Nelson, Richard G. Scott, Howard W. Hunter, Marvin J. Ashton and Boyd K. Packer offered prayers for each country in turn, so every Central American nation received its own dedication.

answers.name: Guatemala
answers.fact: Rededicated by Marvin J. Ashton, October 19, 1991, in Quetzaltenango.

answers.name: Costa Rica
answers.fact: Boyd K. Packer, August 22, 1992.

answers.name: Honduras
answers.fact: Russell M. Nelson, June 1, 1991, on El Picacho above Tegucigalpa.

answers.name: El Salvador
answers.fact: Russell M. Nelson, April 7, 1990, in San Salvador.

answers.name: Nicaragua
answers.fact: Richard G. Scott and Russell M. Nelson, April 9, 1990, in Managua.

answers.name: Panama
answers.fact: Howard W. Hunter, August 24, 1991.

answers.name: Belize
answers.fact: Russell M. Nelson, June 23, 1991, with about 36 members present.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory whose first stake (group of congregations) came 1974-1976 (Northern Ireland counts as UK)
prompts.text_original: From 1974 to 1976 the Church organized first stakes in Scandinavia, France and Chinese-speaking Asia. A country or territory whose very first stake of the Church was organized between 1974 and 1976.
prompts.citation: Global Histories chronologies (Denmark, Sweden, France, Hong Kong, Taiwan)
prompts.note: The United Kingdom does not count: its first stake was in Manchester, England, in 1960.
prompts.summary: Copenhagen became the first stake in Scandinavia in 1974, and Stockholm and Paris followed in 1975. In April 1976 Taipei and Hong Kong received stakes within days of each other, the first in Chinese-speaking lands.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: The Copenhagen Denmark Stake, the first stake in Scandinavia, was organized June 16, 1974.

answers.name: France
answers.fact: The first stake in France was organized in Paris, November 16, 1975, with Gerard Giraud-Carrier as president.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: The Stockholm Sweden Stake was organized April 20, 1975, with Evert W. Perciwall as president.

answers.name: Hong Kong
answers.fact: The Hong Kong Stake was created April 25, 1976, with Poon Shiu-Tat (Sheldon) as president.

answers.name: Taiwan
answers.fact: The Taipei Taiwan Stake was created April 22, 1976, with Chang I-ch'ing as first stake president.
